extracted.intended_audience: job seekers and hiring managers for comedy booker positions (live comedy/talent booking)
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and requirements for hiring and performing as a Comedy Booker at a live comedy venue, covering duties, minimum qualifications, required skills, working conditions, and core competencies expected by the Laugh Factory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role summary / primary objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our team ... we are looking for an organized comedy booker to administer booking and coordinate comedians for live events, including nightly comedy shows, special events, festivals, tours, and other comedic performances. This position will curate and secure comedic act bookings at multiple venues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works closely with Founder, Executive Director & COO, Director of Business Development, administrative staff, talent agents, event planners, and external companies to ensure events run smoothly and audiences experience top-notch performances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify, coordinate, and book comedians
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify, coordinate, and book comedians for live events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curate line-ups appropriate to each event and venue; secure acts for nightly shows, specials, festivals, tours, and other performances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiation and contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Negotiate fees and execute contracts with comedians, agents, and managers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates must demonstrate their ability to enter into and fulfill contracts; capacity to negotiate contracts and fees effectively and timely is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborate with leadership and partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with company leadership and staff, or event planners and partners to ensure that the events run smoothly and the audience experiences high-level comedic performances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate across departments and external partners to deliver cohesive events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue programming and scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule venue programming in advance under specified guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble and organize talent availability and booking schedules to maintain advance programming cadence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logistics coordination
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate logistics such as travel, accommodations, and scheduling for performers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure performers have required travel and lodging arrangements and timely schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry awareness / talent scouting
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep up-to-date with trends and talent in the comedy industry through various means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Continuously monitor emerging acts, trends, and shifts in audience tastes to inform bookings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roster and contact management
rubrics_metrics.description: Control and update company's active roster of talent contacts and data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain accurate contact information and status of talent for efficient booking and outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collect promotional materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Gather talent marketing and promotional materials for use in social media, advertising, and other channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain bios, photos, video, and other assets needed for event promotion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribute promotional materials to talent
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute marketing materials to talent for their promotional use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide talent with assets and guidance so they can promote shows to their audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sales activations and publicity
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate or initiate sales activations, independently or coordinatedly, for publicizing events and line-ups on online platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with marketing/sales to drive ticket sales through activations and online publicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of attendance data
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyze and leverage attendance data to inform ongoing and future programming.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply data-driven insights (attendance, sales) to optimize future bookings and show formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous improvement from feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply information from feedback and data to inform actions and work toward continuous improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Solicit and act on feedback from audiences, talent, and staff to refine bookings and operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain positive relationships with stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain positive relationships with performers, agents, and venue managers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foster long-term productive relationships to support recurring bookings and partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assist with casting calls
rubrics_metrics.description: Assist with casting calls or requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support talent selection processes for specials, festivals, or specific events as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educational credential preference
rubrics_metrics.description: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred, or a combined experience/education as a substitute for the minimum education requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Degree preferred but equivalent experiential combinations accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experience: booker for comedy clubs/live events
rubrics_metrics.description: 3+ years of experience as a full-time booker for comedy club(s) or live events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrated prior full-time booking experience is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication and negotiation ability
rubrics_metrics.description: Proven ability to communicate and negotiate effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates must show track record of professional negotiation and clear communication with talent and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contractual capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must demonstrate their ability to enter into and fulfill contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows legal/commercial competence to commit to and execute contractual agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experience working with agencies and high-profile talent
rubrics_metrics.description: Proven ability to work with talent agencies and with high-profile talent is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comfort navigating agency relationships and the needs of higher-profile performers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred: talent management or event planning experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Previous experience in talent management or event planning is preferred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such experience strengthens candidacy but is not strictly required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred: casting experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Experience in casting for live events is preferred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior casting work is an advantage when evaluating candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work schedule willingness
rubrics_metrics.description: Willingness to work long hours and on weekends and holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position may require irregular hours; candidates must be prepared for nights/weekends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization and prioritization skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong organization and prioritization abilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must manage multiple shows, schedules, and competing priorities effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate in high-pressure environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Capacity to prioritize and orchestrate effective, efficient, and dedicated working pathways in a dynamic, high-pressure business environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to create and follow processes that maintain performance under pressure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline management and problem solving
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to meet deadlines, adapt to change and find creative solutions to complex issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrated adaptability and creative problem-solving when unexpected issues arise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Software proficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google enterprise, or event management software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comfort using common office suites and specialized event/talent management tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity and optimism
rubrics_metrics.description: Creativity and optimism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attitude and creative approach are valued in developing line-ups and solving operational challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to identify comedic talent
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to identify comedic talent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ear/eye for acts that will succeed with venue audiences; talent scouting judgment is essential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receptiveness to feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to accept and learn from feedback and constructive criticism and reorient assignments and tasks toward continuous improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Willingness to iterate on processes and bookings based on critique and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary working environment and travel
rubrics_metrics.description: The Comedy Booker works primarily in an office setting but may also attend events and travel to meet with performers and venue managers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Role requires on-site attendance at shows and occasional travel/meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work hours and pressure expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The position may involve long hours, including evenings and weekends, and requires working well under pressure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates should be prepared for nonstandard hours and high-pressure event days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teamwork and autonomy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Comedy Booker works independently and as part of work groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should be able to self-manage tasks and collaborate within cross-functional teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core competency: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrity - requires being honest and ethical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ethical behavior in negotiations, contracts, and interactions with talent and partners is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core competency: Attention to detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Attention to detail - requires being detail-oriented and thorough in completing tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accuracy in scheduling, contracts, and logistics is essential to avoid errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core competency: Dependability
rubrics_metrics.description: Dependability - requires being reliable, responsible, and dependable in fulfilling obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent follow-through on commitments to talent and internal stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core competency: Cooperation
rubrics_metrics.description: Cooperation - requires being pleasant with others on the job and displaying a good-natured, communicative, and optimistic attitude.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positive interpersonal style to maintain productive workplace relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core competency: Respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Respect - requires being sensitive and respectful to others' needs and feelings and understanding and helpful on the job.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat talent, staff, and partners respectfully to sustain long-term partnerships.
